simulador.dicaUso: To start, press Load and choose teste.bin. Then use Go: in single step mode, each press advances one clock pulse. Tap a register to change the base (hexadecimal, decimal or binary); tap a memory cell to edit it.
simulador.dicaCelular: On a phone held upright, swipe the diagram sideways or rotate the device.

sobre.historia: CPU-8E Web is a browser version of the CPU-8E simulator, created at IESB (Instituto de Educação Superior de Brasília, Brazil) to teach computer architecture.
sobre.acessibilidade: The site is built to work with the keyboard alone and with a screen reader, and follows the WCAG 2.2 guidelines, level AA. A table meant for screen readers holds the state of every register, and at each stop the reader announces what changed on the last clock pulse.
sobre.acessibilidadeTestes: So far, the tests are automated: axe, in the light and dark themes, and a keyboard-only test. Nobody who uses a screen reader every day has tested the site yet. If you do, your help is very welcome: {issue}.
sobre.acessibilidadeIssue: tell us how it went in issue #12

painel.registrador: {nome}: {hex}, {dec} in decimal, {bin} in binary. Press to change the base shown.

pc.nome: Program Counter: the address of the next instruction.

sp.nome: Stack Pointer: the top of the stack, where CAL keeps the return address.

mdr.nome: Memory Data Register: the byte read from or to be written to memory.

ir.nome: Instruction Register: the code of the instruction being executed.

acc.nome: Accumulator: receives the result of the ALU operations.

a.nome: Temporary register with the 1st ALU operand: usually a copy of ACC.

b.nome: Temporary register with the 2nd ALU operand.

ula.nome: Arithmetic logic unit: combines inputs A and B (addition, subtraction, logic operations, shifts) and puts the result on the output.

status.nome: Holds the Z, N and C flags of the last ALU result, which the CU uses to decide jumps.

z.nome: Zero flag: the last ALU result was zero.

n.nome: Negative flag: bit 7 of the last ALU result is 1.

c.nome: Carry flag: the bit left over from an addition or a shift. In SUB and CMP, C = 1 means there was no borrow.

uc.nome: Control unit: on each clock pulse, gives the signals that move the data.

di.nome: Instruction decoder: turns the code in the IR into the instruction.

clk.nome: Clock: the pace of the control unit. From 10 (slowest) to 100 (no wait).

bi.nome: Internal bus: connects the registers and the ALU inside the CPU.

be.nome: Address bus: carries the address from the MAR to the memory.

bd.nome: Data bus: carries the data between the memory and the MDR, both ways.

rd.nome: Read: the memory puts the byte at the address in the MAR on the DB.

wr.nome: Write: the memory stores the DB at the address in the MAR.
